messages:
Alex: Heads-up — the staging runbook page for runtime onboarding is showing a 503 for the diagram image: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/runtime/onboarding -> image path /assets/diagrams/kv-cache-flow.svg  
Sara: ugh, I saw that earlier. Looks like the CDN is returning 503s for that object specifically.  
docs-bot: link-checker: detected 1 asset 503 on /runtime/onboarding (scan at 1758123400)  
Max: I can take this — suspect S3 origin object missing or corrupt. If its reuploaded to the same key it should heal.  
Alex: thanks Max. Can you confirm owner so we can patch the runbook redirect if needed?  
Max: will check bucket ACLs and object existence now. pinging infra if origin denies.  
Frank: infra here — origin returned 503 due to partial multipart upload state, we have a stale multipart marker. I can clear markers but will need confirm before delete.  
Sara: if infra clears the multipart marker, can we reupload a replacement file? I have the svg locally (exported from Figma).  
Max: OK plan: Frank clears multipart markers, Sara uploads new kv-cache-flow.svg to the staging bucket, I will trigger a cache purge for the path.  
Frank: clearing marker now. ETA ~5m.  
Alex: if youre reuploading please include small fallback png at the same path so old browsers still work? Not required but nice.  
Sara: will upload both svg + kv-cache-flow.png. pushing to bucket in 3m.  
Max: after Sara uploads I'll open a tiny PR to the runbook to bump the asset revision and add an alt-text note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4820  
Max: PR includes this change:  
```  
-![KV cache diagram](/assets/diagrams/kv-cache-flow.svg)  
+![KV cache diagram](/assets/diagrams/kv-cache-flow.svg "Shows prefix/KV caching across workers")  
```  
Sara: can you also add `alt="KV cache diagram, prefix and worker KV flows"`? Assistive tech folks will thank you :)  
Max: done in the PR (commits: add-alt + upload-png).  
docs-bot: link-checker: re-scan passed for /runtime/onboarding (0 failures)  
Alex: awesome — thanks everyone. Max if you can mark owner of that runbook section in the docs owner sheet that'd be great. :thumbsup:  
Max: noted, added to owners spreadsheet. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
